notes.title: Monster Girl Jungle 0.1a - Bugfix
notes.notes:
[p]Bugfix: Resolved an issue where the Zelra/Bath event would either not trigger correctly or play too early or immediately after the gemstone collection quest.

This should no longer occur or at least i hope. If you encountered this issue, I recommend either restarting the game or loading a save from before the gemstone quest.[/p][p]If the issue is still present for you during the gemstone quest make sure to just go straight back to Zelra to avoid the bug.[/p][p]
Apologies for the inconvenience![/p][p]This issue didn’t occur during my testing, and I was only able to fix it thanks to the players who experienced it and reported it properly. Your help is greatly appreciated![/p]

notes.title: New Monster Girl Jungle Demo Release
notes.notes:
[h1]Hey everyone![/h1]

The full game isn't released yet, but I've been hard at work updating a lot of core systems. That's why I’ve released a new updated demo, packed with changes. and I’d like to share what I’ve been working on!


[h1]New UI Elements and Changes[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531061/18d2bd88748660ff8115be294332335acecfe114.png[/img]
[b]Day Phase[/b]
The day phase system works similarly to before—you get a limited number of interactions per day before needing to sleep.
What’s new: the day now automatically progresses every 3 minutes (unless the game is paused or you're inactive).

[b]Gift System[/b]
This is a new feature that will be usable in Chapter 2. You’ll be able to give gifts to girls to increase your relationship with them.

[b]Food[/b]
Instead of using a UI similar to the day phase system, I switched to a simpler and more intuitive design.
Like day progression, your food level will now gradually decrease over time.

[b]Quest[/b]
I renamed the quest system to Guide—since it mostly serves to remind or guide players on what to do next.

[b]Settings[/b]
Only the UI was updated here. You can still access the settings menu as usual.

[b]Gallery[/b]
The gallery has been completely redesigned. Here's a screenshot below to show the new layout!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531061/e94c027c4c3b889598c83ee3758b2788c99fe2fe.png[/img]

[b]Minigame[/b]

This is new, connected to the Gift system will be only usable after the girls first encounter.
Basically you will summon a bat character and will give you a simple task about collecting orbs, these can be in different colors and different locations.
For now only applies for the North part of the jungle but once the game progressed enough this will bring a bigger area to explore.

[b]Interactions
[/b]
UI changed as well but it did received a bit of update, the interactions wich does currently nothing will get hidden.


[h1]Quick Menu Update[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531061/8d5c133c3988a8ce6dcb85ecd6a68ed091dbb373.png[/img]
This is the right side of the UI, some people prefer the game without it so from now on you can turn it off in the Settings and turn it back anytime you want.

[h1]Sound Improvements[/h1]

Overall all the sounds were reduced in order to be more balanced between headset and speakers volume.
Basically the game wont be that loud anymore at your own device lowest volume, you can just need to adjust your own speaker or headset instead.

[h1][url=https://www.lovense.com/r/yh7mf4]Lovense Support[/url][/h1]

Yes i indeed added support for Lovense toys, this is mostly thanks to their plugin.
The game should work now with most toys from Lovense. I tried keeping it simple with the commands while setting up different speed for each scene, this might need to be adjusted in the future
with the help of the community.

[h1]Writting[/h1]

Most of the writting got improvements and also changed the story of the player background.


[b]This is all the changes you will be able to see in the Demo build, when the game release come i will reveal new stuffs.
Thank You for the support and hopefully you are going to have a wonderful time during the time you spend in the Monster Girl Jungle.[/b]
